title: Left exactness commutes with the extended smart truncation tower
statement: For a left exact additive functor T between abelian categories, its map on cochain complexes commutes with the extended smart truncation tower, by an isomorphism normalized by the inclusion into T(K). This isomorphism is natural both in cutoffs and in every complex map.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Tags 0118, 0156, 015K and 015X; the indicated proof steps of the CE comparison.

proof.text: Use the proved good-upper-truncation comparison at every finite cutoff, the unique zero-object isomorphism at minus infinity, and the identity at plus infinity.

lean.statement:
theorem extendedTruncationMapIso_naturality {K L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (extendedTruncationTowerMap f) (T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ≫
        (extendedTruncationMapIso T L).hom =
      (extendedTruncationMapIso T K).hom ≫
        extendedTruncationTowerMap ((T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f)
